ns2:section.sectionText: Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken. Two evening midterm exams will administered on selected Wednesdays from 7:00 - 8:20pm. Instructor will give exact dates and times at the start of the term.
